entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... I'm a bit overwhelmed. I bought a jersey a while ago, and I think... I think I need to return it. The website was so confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, can I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Bell, order number 7-4-3-alpha-9. I just... I feel like I picked the wrong size.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here from about two months ago. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just too tight. I thought it would work, but when I tried it on, it was just the wrong size for me. I was hoping I could exchange it for a larger one.
I see. So no tears or issues with the zipper, just a simple sizing issue, correct?
Yes, exactly. I'm just so lost on what to do next. The return pages are hard to follow. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help. Let me quickly review the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. Since you received the item 59 days ago, we can definitely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file right now. Just print that out, attach it to the package with the jersey, and drop it off. Once we process the return, you'll receive a full refund and can place a new order for the correct size.
Wow, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie! You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
